title: Define porting MVP through verified replacement capability
abstract: For a strict software port, judge MVP against the agreed capability to replace the upstream application's baseline functionality rather than successful compilation alone.

source.reference: Generalized project-management and strict-porting proposal; private drafting text not retained

scope_hints.trigger: evaluating an MVP for a strict software port

unresolved: Define per-project measurable replacement acceptance criteria.
